runtime_evidence_note: No fresh runtime evidence within 2h. Profitability, canary and live-readiness claims are not made. Shadow evidence is required before any promotion.
summary: Independent Copilot strategy review at source commit 128fe91d2a0f. Six strategy families exist in cross_chain_strategy_signals.py: cross-venue arbitrage, liquidity-confirmed momentum, dislocation mean-reversion, flow-acceleration, new-liquidity quality, and learned-route replication, plus a forecasted-positive-net-edge composite. Without fresh runtime evidence, no family can be declared profitable or live-ready. Key findings: (1) participation-gate logic exists but shadow evaluation windows and minimum trade thresholds are not yet visibly tied to automated promotion; (2) the forecasted_positive_net_edge signal has no declared train/validation/test split or calibration metric in source; (3) new_liquidity_quality has a pool-age gate but no on-chain sellability check at signal evaluation time; (4) chain-specific cost models (EVM gas, Solana priority fee) are referenced in MarketFeatures but the adequacy of cost modelling for current market conditions is unverifiable without live data.

proposals.title: Collect shadow evaluation data for all six signal families
proposals.description: No fresh runtime evidence is available. Before any promotion decision, collect at least three evaluation windows and eight trades per family on both Solana and EVM. Record gross P&L, fees, slippage, exit success rate and profit factor per window.

evidence.note: Six strategy signal functions defined; no runtime results attached to this review cycle.
MIN_EVALUATION_WINDOWS=3, MIN_EVALUATION_TRADES=8, MIN_PROFIT_FACTOR=1.10 governance thresholds exist but no current window data provided.

proposals.shadow_test: After three full evaluation windows with at least eight qualifying trades per family on each chain, compare profit_factor against 1.10 threshold and largest_loss against average_gain. Reject promotion if profit_factor < 1.10 or largest_loss > 3x average_gain on a money-weighted basis.
proposals.research_plan: Query shadow_strategy_executor trade log for each strategy_id. Aggregate by chain. Compute: gross_profit, gross_loss, profit_factor, win_rate, avg_win, avg_loss, max_loss, fee_total, slippage_total, net_pnl. Report per evaluation window.

proposals.title: Add train/validation/test split and calibration metrics to forecasted_positive_net_edge
proposals.description: The forecasted_positive_net_edge signal in cross_chain_strategy_signals.py applies a composite score but does not declare a feature set, model family, train/validation/test split, or calibration metric (e.g. Brier score, log loss). Without these, the forecast cannot be validated out-of-sample and lookahead leakage cannot be ruled out.

evidence.note: forecasted_positive_net_edge function at line ~228 produces a StrategySignal using composite scoring but no model metadata, split definition or calibration reference.

proposals.shadow_test: After improvement: run the updated signal against a held-out time-ordered test set (no overlap with training). Brier score must be <= 0.25 and net P&L on test set must be positive after costs. Evaluate separately on Solana and EVM.

proposals.title: Add on-chain sellability check to new_liquidity_quality signal at evaluation time
proposals.description: new_liquidity_quality gates on pool age but does not verify sellability (i.e. that a successful sell quote can be obtained at the evaluation moment). A token may pass pool-age and liquidity-depth filters yet be unsellable due to honeypot mechanics, transfer taxes, or one-sided liquidity. This check should be a hard gate before the signal is emitted as eligible.

evidence.note: new_liquidity_quality checks pool_age_hours and liquidity_usd but does not call a sellability probe before setting eligible=True.

proposals.shadow_test: In shadow mode, compare exit success rate of new_liquidity_quality trades before and after adding a sellability gate. Expect exit_failure_rate to fall by at least 20 percentage points. Net P&L must improve on a money-weighted basis after costs.

proposals.title: Verify chain-specific cost models are current for EVM gas and Solana priority fees
proposals.description: MarketFeatures includes estimated_fees_bps and price_impact_bps. Without live data it cannot be confirmed whether the fee estimation methodology reflects current EVM base-fee volatility or current Solana priority-fee markets. Stale cost models can make strategies appear profitable in simulation but negative in execution.

evidence.note: MarketFeatures.estimated_fees_bps and net_edge_bps computation used by all signals; source of fee estimate is not visible in signal layer.
Adapter feeds MarketFeatures; needs review to confirm fee model freshness and accuracy.

proposals.shadow_test: Compute mean(executed_fee_bps - estimated_fees_bps) for the last 100 shadow trades on each chain. If bias exceeds 2 bps in either direction, update the fee model and re-run shadow for a full evaluation window before any promotion.

proposals.title: Extend shadow evaluation of learned_route_replication before any promotion consideration
proposals.description: learned_route_replication extracts profitable route patterns from execution history. This family has the highest latency-sensitivity and the most execution-leakage risk on both EVM and Solana. Additional shadow windows are needed to verify that the route advantage observed in historical data survives real-time execution, MEV competition, and priority fee variation.

evidence.note: learned_route_replication emits eligible=True when route_pattern_confidence > 0.6 and net_edge_bps > threshold, but execution-leakage under competition is not modelled at signal layer.

proposals.shadow_test: Run learned_route_replication in shadow for at least five evaluation windows. Track: simulated_net_pnl vs executed_net_pnl, fill_latency_ms, slippage_vs_quote, priority_fee_variance. Promote only if executed net P&L > 0 and profit_factor >= 1.10 across all five windows on each chain.
